content:
Updates the specified scanner.
You cannot use this endpoint to assign the scanner to a network object. Instead, use the POST
/networks/{network_id}/scanners/{scanner_uuid} endpoint.
Requires the Scan Manager [40] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
integer <int32>
The ID of the scanner.
REQUEST BODY SCHEMA:
application/json
string
The new name for the scanner.
integer <int32>
Pass 1 to force a plugin update.
integer <int32>
Pass 1 to force a UI update.
integer <int32>
Pass 1 to reboot the scanner and run the latest software update (only
valid if automatic updates are disabled).
scanner_id
required
name
force_plugin_update
force_ui_update
finish_update
string
Sets the registration code for the scanner.
integer <int32>
Specifies how often, in minutes, the scanner checks in with Tenable
Vulnerability Management (Amazon Web Services scanners only).
